name: Khakshi
pharmacology_description: Khakshi is a unique combination of valuable natural ingredients. The main ingredient of Fevnil Wild Mustard (Sisymbrium irio) contains sinigrin which acts as febrifuge, antibacterial (especially effective against Salmonella typhi, Salmonella paratyphi) and antiviral. Khakshi is very effective in typhoid, paratyphoid, measles & chicken pox. Khakshi is immunostimulant, demulcent, alterative, analgesic & hepatoprotective.
dosage_description:
Adults: 2-4 teaspoonfuls 2-3 times daily.
Children: 1/2-1 teaspoonfuls 2-3 times daily or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place protect from light.
